feedback:
Approved as the last action run of this iteration. A revise round would need a review and a revision before the race, which leaves no run for racing, so approving is the only way this iteration gets a scored race.

The candidate changes one controller field from the best raced design (iteration 6, score 669.1): kp 3.0 to 2.8, with kd 0.9, base_speed 1.1, ki 0, sensor_weights [-2,-1,0,1,2], line_loss 'last_direction' and the iteration 4 sensor spread (x = -0.024 to 0.024 m) all unchanged. Nothing here predicts how it will perform.

What the earlier evidence shows: the slalom has not finished in any iteration (0 of 20 in iterations 0 to 6), and its max_error has sat at 0.061 to 0.064 across every setting tried. Speed (1.2 to 1.1, iteration 4), sensor spread (iteration 5) and kd (0.8 to 0.9, iteration 6, max_error 0.0613 to 0.0634) did not clear it. rms_error is low on every track (0.006 to 0.018), so the failures are edge excursions on the slalom's sharp alternating bends, not poor average tracking. The kp step is the one lever the earlier Evaluator named that has not yet been tested in isolation at kd 0.9. Iteration 6 is the baseline to beat: oval 20 of 20 at 1.96 s, s-bend 18 of 20 with steering_oscillation 0.40.

How to read the next race: if the s-bend completion falls below 18 of 20 or its steering_oscillation rises above 0.4, revert kp to 3.0 with kd 0.9, since that is the best raced design. If the slalom max_error falls below 0.06 or its line_loss_events drop toward 0.5 while the s-bend holds, keep kp 2.8 and consider a further small step. If the slalom still ends off track with kp 2.8 and the s-bend holds, the next untested lever is sensor_size (0.008 or 0.016) with the iteration 4 spread, because it changes the edge detection without changing the signal scale.
requested_changes: If s-bend completion falls below 18 of 20 or steering_oscillation rises above 0.4 with kp 2.8, revert controller.kp to 3.0 with kd 0.9, the iteration 6 best (669.1), since the s-bend result at iteration 6 was 18 of 20 with oscillation 0.40.

If the slalom max_error is still at or above 0.06 with kp 2.8 and kd 0.9, the slalom has not responded to speed, spread, kd or kp changes, so test geometry.sensor_size of 0.008 or 0.016 with the iteration 4 spread, base_speed 1.1 and kp 2.8 held, as an untested edge-detection lever.

If the slalom max_error falls below 0.06 and its line_loss_events drop toward 0.5 at kp 2.8, keep kp 2.8 and hold base_speed at 1.1 and the iteration 4 spread, since iteration 5 showed the wider spread hurt the s-bend and oval.
